verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ inference engine that runs models locally through `llama cli` and a local `llama serve` with a built-in web UI. It supports local hardware acceleration across Apple silicon, x86, and NVIDIA/AMD GPUs, plus CPU+GPU hybrid offload. Multiple hands-on reports describe running models entirely on personal Macs and desktops, including self-hosted vision workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement guaranteeing no telemetry or network egress of prompts (the `-hf` flow downloads models from Hugging Face, but nothing documents fully offline operation after that).
